20                 SENATOR MAY:   Thank you, 

21    Madam President.  

22                 I rise to acknowledge that this is a 

23    chapter amendment to a bill originally introduced 

24    by our former colleague Senator Thomas.  As the 

25    new chair of Consumer Protection, I am grateful 


                                                                614

 1    for the chance to build on the work that he did 

 2    when he was our colleague.

 3                 Consumer protection policy at the 

 4    state level is becoming even more important now 

 5    that the federal government is abdicating its 

 6    role to protect consumers by gutting the 

 7    Consumer Financial Protection Bureau and now, 

 8    today, the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act.

 9                 As the president and his entourage 

10    of oligarchs remove the guardrails on fraud and 

11    scams and usury, it will be up to us to find ways 

12    to protect the people of New York from the 

13    potential harms that those could create.

14                 So I look forward to doing this 

15    work, and I vote aye.

16                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Senator
